title: Smart scene dedup, music modes & overlays
notes: AI scene-similarity dedup — the same scene shot from a different angle is now recognised and de-duplicated using the neural network's embeddings, not just a pixel hash.
Background music modes — choose None, Smart (scenic parts) or Whole video.
World-class text overlays — five styles (minimal, elegant, bold, lower third, boxed) with font, colour, position and animation controls.
A run log is written next to your footage so any error is recorded even if the app crashes.
Keyless install, HEVC preview, overnight durability and correct icon all included.
